summary: SQLite plugin hardcodes SetMaxOpenConns(1) instead of respecting config.SQL.MaxConns like MySQL and PostgreSQL plugins, causing connection bottlenecks and failures under high load (1000+ concurrent workflows).
userImpact: Users cannot configure SQLite connection pool sizes, causing failures and timeouts at high concurrency levels.
rootCause: SQLite plugin hardcodes db.SetMaxOpenConns(1) and db.SetMaxIdleConns(1) instead of reading from config.SQL.MaxConns and config.SQL.MaxIdleConns
proposedFix: Respect config.SQL.MaxConns and config.SQL.MaxIdleConns like other database plugins, and add a warning when max conns > 1 without WAL mode enabled
keyQuote: At ~1000 concurrent workflows, internal operations exceed the 5-second ShardIOTimeout and fail with context deadline exceeded.
